All tests pass.

`habit list` now marks any habit not yet done today with `(not done today)`, so running it surfaces reminders without a new flag or command. Added a test in `test/commands.test.js`.

"Reminders" could mean more than this — I built the smallest uncontroversial piece (a visual flag in existing output) rather than guess at delivery/timing. If you want more, options:
1. Add a `habit due` command that lists only undone habits (quick filtered view).
2. Wire up a cron/OS notification to run `habit list` and alert on undone habits at a set time.
3. Add a `--json` output flag for scripting reminders into another tool.

I'd recommend option 1 next if you want something actionable beyond `list`.
